capabilities: Change element colors, gradient series, and saved color presets
Customize node shapes and 160 diagram settings across 29 types
Insert and edit components in 32 diagram types via right-click
Export diagrams as PNG, SVG, or animated files
Write all styling back to the Mermaid block in the note
disambiguation: Not a general note or code editor; it only styles, customizes, and exports diagrams rendered by the Pele plugin.
extras: Seven-day free trial, then $5 one-time purchase via Dodo Payments; export and animation require an active trial or license. Source is proprietary; requires Obsidian 1.15.0+.
intentEvidence: Style, customize, animate, and export Mermaid diagrams rendered by Pele in Obsidian.
problem: Restyling a Pele-rendered diagram otherwise means hand-editing Mermaid code, with no color pickers, shape controls, presets, or image and animation export.
